title: Resolved relative comparison of short exact rows before cone passage
statement: Assume derived module categories on every scheme [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X to S, f-prime:X-prime to S-prime, g:S-prime to S and g-prime:X-prime to X form a cartesian square. Fix K in D(O_X), K-prime in D(O_X-prime), phi:L(g-prime)* K to K-prime [def-pc-derived-pullback], and opens U,V covering X. Use the pinned global arrow a and local arrows b(W) [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. Let G be underived module direct image along g, F its cochain functor and eta the right-derived localization comparison [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data]. There exist short complexes P on S and P-prime on S-prime, both short exact, and an actual short-complex morphism m:P to P-prime.map F. There are six vertex isomorphisms identifying Lg* Q(P.X1), Lg* Q(P.X2), Lg* Q(P.X3) with a.left, b(U).left direct-sum b(V).left and b(U intersection V).left, and Q(P-prime.X1), Q(P-prime.X2), Q(P-prime.X3) with the corresponding right vertices. The adjoint mates of Q(m.tau1) eta, Q(m.tau2) eta and Q(m.tau3) eta, after these vertex comparisons, are a.hom, biprod.map b(U).hom b(V).hom and b(U intersection V).hom, respectively. No mapping-cone identification, cone map, tensor-pullback complex or triangle assertion is included.

proof.text: Apply the resolved-row core theorem to obtain both short exact rows, their strict morphism, all six vertex comparisons, and the three normalized adjunction-mate equations.

For each normalized equation, apply the inverse adjunction Hom equivalence and simplify by Equiv.symm_apply_apply. Postcompose with the corresponding target vertex isomorphism; associativity and its inverse-hom identity cancel the inverse comparison. Package the three resulting identities with the same witnesses and short-exactness proofs.

from.place: Resolved relative short exact row comparison, before the cone-to-quotient passage in lem-pc-relative-mv-direct-image-homotopy-comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeMV_direct_image_rows
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let G := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let F := G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let η := schemeMVDirectImageLocalization g
    let adj := relativeMVAdj g
    let a := relativeMVGlobalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    let b := relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    ∃ (P : ShortComplex (CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) ℤ))
      (P' : ShortComplex (CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ))
      (m : P ⟶ P'.map F)
      (e₁ : (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₁) ≅ a.left)
      (e₂ : (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₂) ≅
        (b U).left ⊞ (b V).left)
      (e₃ : (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₃) ≅ (b (U ⊓ V)).left)
      (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₁ ≅ a.right)
      (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₂ ≅ (b U).right ⊞ (b V).right)
      (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₃ ≅ (b (U ⊓ V)).right),
      P.ShortExact ∧ P'.ShortExact ∧
      (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₁ ≫ η.app P'.X₁) ≫ e₁'.hom =
        e₁.hom ≫ a.hom ∧
      (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₂ ≫ η.app P'.X₂) ≫ e₂'.hom =
        e₂.hom ≫ biprod.map (b U).hom (b V).hom ∧
      (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₃ ≫ η.app P'.X₃) ≫ e₃'.hom =
        e₃.hom ≫ (b (U ⊓ V)).hom
